svg.title: step-flow: a side pane that lists every step Claude finished and asks for your decision
svg.desc: Animated demo. Run /flow to open the pane. Over hours, each finished step is added to the list, with a deferred step showing why it is fine to skip and a step that needs a decision in yellow. Claude asks whether to use A or B. Scroll the pane up, click the step to see its details, and press Choose A in the pane to send the choice to Claude.

A side chat that doesn't affect the session conte…
As Claude works for hours, each finished step is added to the pane.
Hours later, Claude asks whether to go with A or B.
Scroll the pane up to find the step marked "Needs decision".
Click it to see the issue and each option.
Click "Choose A". Claude continues with A, and the step shows "Decided".
